blocks.text: Veins woh naliyan hain jo khoon ko jism ke mukhtalif hisson se dil ki taraf le jati hain. Pulmonary veins ke siwa tamam veins deoxygenated khoon le jati hain. Vein ki deewar mein bhi artery wali teen tahein hoti hain. Bahar wali tah tunica externa (adventitia) connective aur elastic tissue se bani hai. Darmiyani tah tunica media nisbatan (comparatively) patli hai, is mein muscles thore aur elastic fibres kam hote hain. Andar wali tah tunica intima endothelial cells ki patli tah hai.

blocks.alt: Kati hui vein seedhi-dar belanon ki shakal mein: chaura lumen jis ke andar valve hai, tunica intima (endothelium) ki tah; smooth muscles ka patla tunica media; aur bahari tunica externa, jis mein pehlu se venule milti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.8: Vein ki banawat (textbook ki Figure 11.8 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Valve, Tunica intima (endothelium), Lumen, Smooth muscles, Tunica media, Tunica externa, Venule.

blocks.text: Vein ki darmiyani tah artery ke muqable mein patli hoti hai, kyun ke veins ko zyada dabao bardasht nahin karna parta. Khali artery phir bhi khokhli nali ki shakal mein rehti hai, lekin khali vein khali ghubbare ki tarah pichak jati hai. Veins mein semilunar valves hote hain jo dil ki taraf jate hue khoon ko wapas behne se rokte hain. Aas paas ke muscles jab sukarte hain to veins ko dabate hain, aur is dabao se khoon ko dil ki taraf wapas jane mein madad milti hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Artery (Figure 11.6) se muqabla karein: vein ka tunica media patla aur lumen chaura hai, aur us mein valve hai jo khoon ko wapas behne nahin deta.

Chhoti veins mil kar bari veins banati hain aur aakhir mein vena cavae (inferior vena cava aur superior vena cava) banti hain, jo khoon ko dil ke daen atrium mein daalti hain. Phephron se aane wali pulmonary veins baen atrium mein khulti hain.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf surkh artery se arterioles nikalti hain; har capillary loop ke shuru mein precapillary sphincter hai. Jamni capillaries arterioles ko venules se jorti hain, jo daen taraf neeli vein mein khulti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.9: Arterioles, capillaries aur venules ka talluq (textbook ki Figure 11.9 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Artery, Arteriole, Precapillary sphincters, Capillaries, Venule, Vein.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khoon ka rasta: artery -> arteriole -> capillaries -> venule -> vein. Rang surkh (oxygenated) se neela (deoxygenated) hota jata hai kyunke capillaries mein oxygen tissues ko di jati hai.
